item.description: Thune says he supports the legislation and his conference is discussing how to pass it.

item.title: Netflix walks away from Warner Bros deal, clearing the path for Paramount
item.description: “We believe we would have been strong stewards of Warner Bros.′ iconic brands,” Netflix’s co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters said in a joint statement. “But this transaction was always a ‘nice to have’ at the right price, not a ‘must have’ at any price.”

item.title: Anthropic CEO says AI company ‘cannot in good conscience accede’ to Pentagon’s demands
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said Thursday the artificial intelligence company “cannot in good conscience accede” to the Pentagon’s demands to allow unrestricted use of its technology, deepening the unusually public clash with the Trump administration that is threatening to pull its contract and take other drastic steps by Friday.

item.title: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro asks judge to toss out indictment against him
item.description: Maduro's attorney says the U.S. government violated his client’s due process rights by blocking funds.

item.title: In new court order, Terrion Arnold tied to Florida robberies
item.description: A new seven-page order from Hillsborough County Circuit Judge J. Logan Murphy has tied Detroit Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold to an alleged robbery that stemmed from stolen property from an Airbnb.

item.title: Red Wings reportedly have offer on table for 6-8 defenseman
item.description: Could the Detroit Red Wings be getting even bigger on defense soon? The Red Wings reportedly made a trade offer for 6-foot-8 defenseman Tyler Myers of Vancouver, who was held out of the lineup Wednesday against Winnipeg while the Canucks considered a trade offer.

item.title: Dylan Larkin scores his 2nd goal of game in OT to lift Red Wings past Senators, 2-1
item.description: Dylan Larkin scored in his second goal of game at 1:50 of overtime, John Gibson made 26 saves and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Ottawa Senators 2-1 on Thursday night.

item.title: No. 13 Michigan State holds on to edge No. 8 Purdue, 76-74
item.description: Carson Cooper scored 15 points, Kur Teng had 13 and No. 13 Michigan State survived Braden Smith’s missed 3-point attempt with a second to play for a 76-74 victory over No. 8 Purdue on Thursday night.
